Container.Name: brainless-dash
Container.Overview: Brainless-Dash: a lightweight, mobile-first Unraid dashboard. CPU, memory, temperatures, storage capacity per array disk and live network bandwidth. Read-only, runs as non-root, no privileged mode.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the dashboard listens on. Note: with host networking, this is the host port directly.

Config.Name: Refresh Interval (ms)
Config.Description: How often the dashboard polls for new stats, in milliseconds. Minimum 500.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Uvicorn log level: critical, error, warning, info, debug, trace.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: System timezone (IANA format, e.g. Australia/Sydney, Europe/London, America/New_York).

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: URL of the Plex Media Server. Only used when Plex Token is set.

Config.Name: Sonarr URL
Config.Description: URL of the Sonarr instance. Only used when Sonarr API Key is set.

Config.Name: Sonarr API Key
Config.Description: Sonarr API key. Set to enable the upcoming episodes card. Leave empty to disable.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Plex authentication token. Set to enable the Plex streams card. Leave empty to disable.

Config.Name: SABnzbd URL
Config.Description: URL of the SABnzbd instance. Only used when SABnzbd API Key is set.

Config.Name: SABnzbd API Key
Config.Description: SABnzbd API key. Set to enable the SABnzbd downloads card. Leave empty to disable.

Config.Name: qBittorrent URL
Config.Description: URL of the qBittorrent WebUI. Only used when qBittorrent Password is set.

Config.Name: qBittorrent Username
Config.Description: qBittorrent WebUI username.

Config.Name: qBittorrent Password
Config.Description: qBittorrent WebUI password. Used if API Key is not set.

Config.Name: qBittorrent API Key
Config.Description: qBittorrent API key (v5.0+, preferred over username/password). Set either this or Password to enable the card.

Config.Name: Minecraft Server Host
Config.Description: Hostname or IP of the Minecraft server. Set to enable the server status card. Leave empty to disable.

Config.Name: Minecraft Server Port
Config.Description: Minecraft server query port.

Config.Name: Minecraft RCON Port
Config.Description: Minecraft RCON port. Required to enable in-dashboard chat.

Config.Name: Minecraft RCON Password
Config.Description: Minecraft RCON password (enable-rcon=true in server.properties). Set to enable chat from the dashboard.

Config.Name: HTTPS Certificate
Config.Description: Path inside the container to a manually supplied TLS certificate (e.g. /data/certs/cert.pem). Leave empty if using ACME_DOMAIN instead.

Config.Name: HTTPS Key
Config.Description: Path inside the container to a manually supplied TLS private key. Leave empty if using ACME_DOMAIN instead.

Config.Name: ACME Domain
Config.Description: Domain name for automatic Let's Encrypt certificate (e.g. dash.example.com). Also set ACME_EMAIL and either ACME_DNS_PLUGIN (recommended) or configure port forwarding for HTTP-01. Leave empty to disable.

Config.Name: ACME Email
Config.Description: Email address for Let's Encrypt account registration and expiry notices.

Config.Name: ACME DNS Plugin
Config.Description: DNS provider plugin for DNS-01 challenge (no port forwarding needed). Supported: cloudflare, digitalocean, duckdns. Leave empty to use HTTP-01 instead.

Config.Name: ACME DNS Credentials File
Config.Description: Path inside the container to the DNS provider credentials file (e.g. /data/certs/cloudflare.ini). Mount the file into the container as a read-only volume.

Config.Name: ACME Challenge Port
Config.Description: HTTP-01 fallback only (ignored when ACME_DNS_PLUGIN is set). Port certbot binds for the HTTP-01 challenge — forward port 80 on your router here.

Config.Name: Certs Storage
Config.Description: Persistent storage for ACME certificates and credentials files. Must be read-write. Certs are lost without this mount.

Config.Name: Host /sys
Config.Description: Read-only access to /sys for hardware temperature sensors. Required.

Config.Name: Host /proc
Config.Description: Read-only access to /proc for CPU, memory, network counters. Required.

Config.Name: Host /mnt
Config.Description: Read-only access to /mnt for Unraid array, cache and user share capacity reporting. Required.
